parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: Interface Name: The resource to which the rule applies. It must match the interface name in the console's interface details.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse bind-sentinel-block-fallback-definition --app-name spring-cloud-a --namespace prod --fallback-id 21 --target-type 1 --resource /a --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse BindSentinelBlockFallbackDefinition --region cn-hangzhou --TargetType 1 --Resource '/a' --AcceptLanguage zh --Namespace prod --FallbackId 21 --AppName 'spring-cloud-a'
